title: Real-time Learning and Evolution in Robotic Art Installations
abstract: arXiv:2609.13352v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present three robotic art installations which explore the aesthetics of adaptive behavior. Through embodied machine leaning and digital evolution, these works draw viewers into an artificial ecosystem in which open-ended novelty, trial-and-error learning, competition, and cooperation emerge in real time. Research-creation practices are examined in relation to these works, focusing on how they redefine the role of artists within a human-machine collective while examining points of convergence and divergence between artistic and engineering approaches to adaptive robotics. The systems in question use learning and evolutionary processes not as a means to optimize a specific solution, but as an aesthetic experience on its own, suggesting new modes of interdisciplinary art-science research. translated_title: 机器人艺术装置中的实时学习与进化
translated_abstract: 我们展示了三个探索适应性行为美学的机器人艺术装置。通过具身机器学习和数字进化，这些作品将观众引入一个人工生态系统，其中开放式的新颖性、试错学习、竞争与合作实时涌现。本文结合这些作品考察了研究-创作实践，重点关注它们如何重新定义艺术家在人机集体中的角色，同时探讨了适应性行为机器人学中艺术方法与工程方法之间的异同。这些系统并非将学习和进化过程作为优化特定解决方案的手段，而是将其本身作为一种审美体验，为跨学科艺术-科学研究提出了新的模式。最后，我们讨论了提升观众审美体验的策略与实践，包括展示环境以及时间维度等方面。
tldr: 本文介绍了三个通过具身机器学习与数字进化实时涌现适应性行为的机器人艺术装置，将学习和进化过程本身作为审美体验，重新定义了人机集体中艺术家的角色，并为艺术与科学的跨学科研究开辟了新模式。
en_tdlr: This paper presents three robotic art installations that use embodied machine learning and digital evolution to make adaptive behavior an aesthetic experience in real time, redefining the artist's role within human-machine collectives and suggesting new modes of interdisciplinary art-science research.
